channel.title: Among The Letters Opportunities (free list)
channel.description: Writing contests, residencies, fellowships, grants and paid markets, checked against official pages.

item.title: Quebec Writers' Federation, 2027 Writing Mentorships and National Translation Mentorship
item.description: Paired mentorships with established writers, and a free-to-apply Mairuth Sarsfield Mentorship for Black, Indigenous and racialized writers. Deadline 2026-11-11.

item.title: CBC Books, 2027 CBC Short Story Prize
item.description: One of the best-known open contests for Canadian fiction, with long and short lists that bring real attention to new names. Deadline 2026-11-01.

item.title: The Malahat Review, Open Season Awards
item.description: Three genres, three winners published in the spring issue. Poetry entries hold up to three poems. Deadline 2026-11-01.

item.title: MASS MoCA, The Studios at MASS MoCA, July to December 2027
item.description: Residencies beside one of the largest contemporary art museums in North America. Free to apply. Deadline 2026-11-01.

item.title: Stanford University, Wallace Stegner Fellowship, 2027 to 2029
item.description: Two years of workshops for poets and fiction writers. A fee waiver request is built into the application. Deadline 2026-11-02.

item.title: Trillium Arts, 2027 Individual Artist Residencies
item.description: Private suites near Asheville. Every 2027 residency is filled through this single cycle. Deadline 2026-11-04.

item.title: Saltonstall Foundation, 2027 Residencies
item.description: Poetry and fiction this season, with no application fee. Residencies cannot be deferred. Deadline 2026-12-06.

item.title: Writers' Federation of Nova Scotia, Nova Writes Competition
item.description: For unpublished work by emerging Nova Scotian writers, including the Budge Wilson Short Story Prize. Deadline 2027-01-14.

item.title: FreeFall Magazine, Annual Prose and Poetry Contest 2026 to 2027
item.description: Up to 3,000 words of prose or three poems per entry, with months to revise before it closes. Deadline 2027-04-30.

item.title: The Welkin Press, The Welkin Writing Prize
item.description: A free international prize for pieces up to 100 words, judged on a rolling basis. Deadline 2027-01-02.
